## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: aca ingest x-bookmarks submits an operation through OperationService and the...

The system SHALL ensure that aca ingest x-bookmarks submits an operation through OperationService and the CLI, HTTP, MCP, and frontend transports all list the source.

#### Scenario: aca ingest x-bookmarks submits an operation through OperationService and the...

WHEN `register-the-x-bookmarks-source-descriptor-and-config` is implemented
THEN aca ingest x-bookmarks submits an operation through OperationService and the CLI, HTTP, MCP, and frontend transports all list the source.

### Requirement: The descriptor reports ready=false with code x_bookmarks_credentials_missing...

The system SHALL ensure that the descriptor reports ready=false with code x_bookmarks_credentials_missing when auth_token or ct0 is unset.

#### Scenario: The descriptor reports ready=false with code x_bookmarks_credentials_missing...

WHEN `register-the-x-bookmarks-source-descriptor-and-config` is implemented
THEN The descriptor reports ready=false with code x_bookmarks_credentials_missing when auth_token or ct0 is unset.

### Requirement: The source fixture registry test passes with x_bookmarks covered by a...

The system SHALL ensure that the source fixture registry test passes with x_bookmarks covered by a network-free fixture.

#### Scenario: The source fixture registry test passes with x_bookmarks covered by a...

WHEN `register-the-x-bookmarks-source-descriptor-and-config` is implemented
THEN The source fixture registry test passes with x_bookmarks covered by a network-free fixture.

### Requirement: sources.d/x_bookmarks.yaml schedules the source at a quiet hour with a...

The system SHALL ensure that sources.d/x_bookmarks.yaml schedules the source at a quiet hour with a conservative max_entries default.

#### Scenario: sources.d/x_bookmarks.yaml schedules the source at a quiet hour with a...

WHEN `register-the-x-bookmarks-source-descriptor-and-config` is implemented
THEN sources.d/x_bookmarks.yaml schedules the source at a quiet hour with a conservative max_entries default.
